Cathie Wood's ARK sold about $11.8 million of Palantir stock, which GuruFocus described as routine rebalancing, and a Motley Fool article noted the stock fell after an analyst upgrade.
drivers: Raised 2026 revenue guidance
Q3 sales up 96% on AI demand
New UK competition for NHS data contract
ARK Invest sale of Palantir shares
